verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks from BigQuery. The Pub/Sub material describes a BigQuery subscription used to stream data into BigQuery, which is inbound ingestion and a host-platform service, not webhooks. Continuous queries can export output rows to destinations, but those destinations are not named as HTTP callbacks. These items are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
